moments.author: Daniel Lewis
moments.quote: There was never a $BETR without @vishal_better. That demands respect.
moments.why: A stunning public nod on X used to justify a board coup—Vishal Garg claims Lewis used that praise to win trust and edge him out as CEO.

moments.author: Vishal Garg
moments.why: The ousted Better CEO charged that his successor deceived him via public support on X—this dramatic internal saga is fueling major headlines.

moments.author: Nneka Ogwumike
moments.quote: I feel very fulfilled … I’m retiring from the WNBA.
moments.why: WNBA icon and players union leader announcing her retirement after 15 seasons hits both sports and cultural conversations hard with men 25–45.

moments.quote: The Cavs are trading Dennis Schröder and cash to the Hornets for Tre Mann.
